const shortText = (text: string): string =>
  text.length > QUOTE_CHARS ? `${text.slice(0, QUOTE_CHARS)}…` : text;

const short = (name: string | undefined): string =>
  name === undefined ? "nothing" : name.length > 40 ? `${name.slice(0, 40)}...` : name;
